verses.ptLiteralVerse: Perguntaram os chefes dos filisteus: que fazem aqui estes hebreus? tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites
tokens.kjv: Jezreel.

verses.ptLiteralVerse: Madrugaram, pois, Davi e os seus homens, a fim de partirem, pela manhã, e voltarem à terra dos filisteus; e os filisteus subiram a Jizreel.
